Title: Information security roles and responsibilities
Description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

Title: Privileged access rights
Description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

Title: Authentication information
Description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.

Title: Information backup
Description: Backup copies of information shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

Title: Information security incident management planning
Description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents.

Title: Monitoring activities
column6: systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour.
